label_origin: Authored synthetic identities, independent of scorer decisions; these labels are scenario assumptions, not verified customer identities.

cases.identity_rationale: One synthetic person exported with different capitalization and local phone formatting.
One synthetic person whose second source omits their phone and abbreviates their surname.
The scenario assigns both records to one synthetic person who changed phone; the second source omits accents. This identity cannot be established from the payload alone.
Two distinct synthetic people share a common name but have separate contact details.
One synthetic company exported with an abbreviated legal name and a www domain prefix.
Two separately registered synthetic legal companies share a trading name and website. Their trusted registration IDs identify different legal entities.
Two distinct synthetic companies operate in separate countries with separate websites.
The scenario assigns both records to one synthetic company before and after a rename. A retained domain alone does not prove that identity in real data.
